_comment: The sentence-first curriculum. Each level introduces one grammar pattern; its
vocabulary is derived from the sentences generated for it, not authored here.
`required` lists words the pattern cannot be taught without — the generator is
told to exercise them. `additions` are words the corpus lacks entirely; they are
the ONLY vocabulary the model may use beyond the existing 500 words, and each
gets a fresh UUID on first use (and an mp3 from `npm run audio`).
Levels are cumulative: a level-N sentence may use any word from levels 1..N.

levels.name: 是 · Identity
levels.subtitle: I am, you are · 不 · 吗
levels.focus: The copula 是 and simple description. Teach: `S 是 O` (我是学生), `S 很 ADJ` (他很忙), possessive 的 (我的猫), negation with 不 (我不是老师), yes/no questions with 吗, and the adverbs 也 and 都. Introduce pronouns, a few everyday nouns, and the most common greetings. Keep every sentence 3-6 words.

levels.name: 动词 · Doing things
levels.subtitle: Subject-verb-object · 什么
levels.focus: Basic transitive sentences. Teach: `S V O` (我喝茶), negation of verbs with 不 (他不看书), the question word 什么 sitting in the object slot (你想吃什么？), and 喜欢/想/要 followed by a verb. Introduce everyday verbs and the concrete nouns they take as objects.

levels.name: 时间 · Time & completion
levels.subtitle: When things happen · 了
levels.focus: Time expressions and completed actions. Teach: time-when phrases BEFORE the verb (我今天买书 — never 我买书今天), the aspect particle 了 for completed actions (他昨天来了), numbers and counting, telling time, and days/dates. Introduce numbers, time nouns, and measure words.

levels.name: 在 · Places & movement
levels.subtitle: Where things are · 从…到…
levels.focus: Location and motion. Teach: `S 在 PLACE V` with the location before the verb (我在家里吃饭), existential 在 (书在桌子上), the frame 从…到… (从学校到家), localizers 里/上/下, and directional verbs 去/来/回/进/出. Introduce places, furniture, and vehicles.

levels.name: 想 · Wanting & asking
levels.subtitle: Modals · requests · 吧
levels.focus: Modal verbs and making requests. Teach: modal + verb (我想学中文, 你可以帮我吗), the difference between 想 (would like) and 要 (want/will), 会 vs 能 vs 可以, negation 不能/不可以, suggestions with 吧 (我们一起去吧), softened questions with 呢, and prohibition with 别. Introduce activity verbs.

levels.name: 比 · Describing & comparing
levels.subtitle: A 比 B · degree adverbs
levels.focus: Adjectives and comparison. Teach: `A 比 B ADJ` (中文比英文难), `A 跟 B 一样 ADJ`, degree adverbs 很/太/非常/最/更/比较, and 的 linking an adjective to a noun (漂亮的房子). Introduce adjectives, colors, and body parts.

levels.name: 过 · Experience & habit
levels.subtitle: 过 · 着 · 已经 · 常常
levels.focus: Aspect and frequency. Teach: 过 for past experience (我去过中国), 着 for ongoing state, 在 for progressive action, and the adverbs 已经/还/就/才/再/又 in their correct pre-verb position. Add frequency adverbs 常常/总是/一直. Contrast 了 (completed) with 过 (ever experienced).

levels.name: 因为 · Joining ideas
levels.subtitle: 因为…所以 · 如果…就
levels.focus: Multi-clause sentences. Teach the paired connectives that Mandarin uses in BOTH halves: 因为…所以…, 虽然…但是…, 如果…就…. Also 或者 vs 还是, 而且, 不过, 为了, 除了. Sentences here are longer (6-9 words) and express reasons, conditions, and contrasts.
examples: 因为我很忙，所以不能去。
如果你想学，就每天练习。

levels.name: 把 · People & feelings
levels.subtitle: 把 · 被 · family · emotions
levels.focus: The disposal and passive constructions, plus people. Teach: `S 把 O V了` moving the object before the verb (我把书给了他), the passive with 被 (书被他拿走了), and the coverbs 对/向/往/给 marking a target. Introduce family members, occupations, and emotion words.

levels.name: 社会 · Ideas & society
levels.subtitle: Abstract topics · formal register
levels.focus: Abstract and written-register Mandarin. Teach: 的 nominalizing a whole phrase (社会的发展), topic-comment sentences, and 对…来说 / 关于 framing. Topics are work, education, economy, environment, and technology. Sentences are longer and more formal, but must still be built from the cumulative pool.
examples: 教育对社会的发展很重要。
